nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the React/Vite frontend: builds the app with Node 24 and serves the compiled static assets via an Nginx runtime image.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-stage build separates the npm build toolchain (node:24-alpine) from the lean nginx:alpine runtime, minimizing final image size. A ponytail comment on the npm ci line documents a deliberate --legacy-peer-deps workaround for an openapi-typescript peer-dependency mismatch under the older npm bundled in node:24-alpine.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Build stage using node:24-alpine: installs dependencies with npm ci and runs the Vite production build.

nodes.name: runtime
nodes.summary: Runtime stage using nginx:alpine: serves the built static assets and a custom nginx.conf.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes node_modules and dist from the Docker build context to keep frontend image builds fast and clean.
